verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents explicit multi-repo linking to catch cross-repo breaking changes/API mismatches, large-diff summarization as logical cohorts with diagrams, and org-wide central configuration—directly addressing coherent review across repos/monorepos. However, there's no independent evidence validating this at real monorepo scale or accuracy of cross-repo detection. Missing for 10: hands-on/community validation of multi-repo or monorepo review coherence, evidence of performance on very large codebases, and detail on how logical-cohort summaries scale to monorepo-sized diffs.
